build_ResNet50_conv4_body: build a ResNet50 conv4 body model with 3, 4, 6 residual blocks per stage
build_ResNet101_conv5_body: build a ResNet101 conv5 body model with 3, 4, 23, 3 residual blocks per stage
build_ResNet152_conv5_body: build a ResNet152 conv5 body model with 3, 8, 36, 3 residual blocks per stage
create_add_stage: create a ResNet stage by stacking n residual blocks with specified dimensions and dilation
create_add_residual_block: create a residual block with transformation, shortcut, sum, and ReLU operations
